name: Mica-v0.1-4B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-24. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.215 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-25.

benchmarks.name: JevBench original (accuracy %)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Public sets' table, n=72: Mica 100.0 vs Qwen3.5-4B 91.7. BF16 PyTorch, vendor eval code.

benchmarks.name: JevBench hard (accuracy %)
benchmarks.config: Same table, n=111: Mica 69.5 vs Qwen3.5-4B 61.0. Through llama.cpp server the hard tier reads 64.9.

benchmarks.name: Sealed eval (English)
benchmarks.config: Figure panel 'Sealed eval (English)', Mica v0.1 4B bar 67.0 vs Jev 1.13 74.1, Qwen3.5-4B base 55.0. Vendor-written sealed set, created after the training freeze. Read off the card figure assets/accuracy.png (six-panel bar chart, printed value above every bar), by eye: +-0.5. Single forward pass, unsupported inputs counted wrong. Second read matched.
